name: Sports Injury Rehabilitation
description: Targeted programs to help athletes and active individuals recover from sprains, strains, and overuse injuries while preventing future setbacks.

name: Post-Surgical Recovery
description: Guided rehabilitation after joint replacement, ligament repair, or spinal surgery to restore strength, mobility, and confidence.

name: Chronic Pain Management
description: Evidence-based treatment for persistent back, neck, and joint pain using manual therapy, exercise, and lifestyle coaching.

name: Manual Therapy & Mobilization
description: Hands-on techniques to reduce stiffness, improve joint movement, and release tight muscles for faster pain relief.

name: Pre & Post-Natal Wellness
description: Safe, supportive exercise and education to maintain strength, manage discomfort, and recover after childbirth.

name: Balance & Fall Prevention
description: Personalized balance training for older adults and neurological conditions to improve stability and reduce fall risk.
